item.title: RDF for Intrepid Unix Hackers: Transmuting N-Triples
item.description: How to install and use the Raptor RDF parser toolkit to convert RDF data from one serialization format to another, such as to N-Triples.

item.title: RDF for Intrepid Unix Hackers: Grepping N-Triples
item.description: How to process RDF data in the line-oriented N-Triples format by pipelining standard Unix tools such as grep, cut, awk, sort, and uniq.
